schemeScope: Combined Ordinary scheme. PDF 12–14 Léamhthuiscint A with the Paper 2 notes; 15–17 Léamhthuiscint B and its deduction panel; 18–22 Prós Ainmnithe (2A); 23–24 Prós Roghnach (2B); 25–28 Filíocht Ainmnithe (3A); 29–30 Filíocht Roghnach (3B); 31–32 modified marking (SMM; 32 is its Paper 1 table). PDF 1–11 belong to Paper 1; 33–35 blank.
reviewMethod: Every paper page (1 cover, 2 and 15–16 blank or acknowledgements, 3 instructions, 8 literature directions) and every applicable scheme page read in the text layer and checked against the printed page; each prompt and scheme slice is asserted against the PDFs by the builder.

nonPoolDecisions: Reading: all ten questions are required (both passages); each printed (a)/(b) part is a 5-mark practice card. “3 mharc + 2 mharc” items are order-dependent (first correct point 3, second 2) and stay whole at 0/3/5; single answers with a printed partial (“= 3 mharc”) allow 0/3/5, otherwise 0/5.
Reading language: “Gaeilge lochtach: 0 - 5 a bhaint den iomlán a gnóthaíodh” is one deduction from each 50-mark passage total; cards state it without applying it inside a part.

Prescribed prose (2A): Hurlamaboc (a) prints five 5-mark sub-questions: the whole option is a 25-mark card and every sub-question is also a practice card (“3 mharc + 2 mharc” sub-questions keep 0/3/5). 2A(b) offers the film Cáca Milis or the play An Lasair Choille: one 25-mark card each. Dís (c) is one 25-mark question and one card.

Optional prose (2B): (a) novel extract: naming 1 + events 22 + title/author 2; (b) film or play: events 23 + title/writer 2, one card for both alternatives; (c) short story: theme 1 + events 22 + title/author 2.

Poetry: each prescribed poem (3A) prints (i) 8, (ii) 8, (iii) 9: the poem is one card and each sub-question a practice card. Each optional poem (3B) prints (i) 9, (ii) 7, (iii) 7 and title/poet 2 inside one card.
Literature language: “[Gaeilge lochtach: 0-4 a bhaint den iomlán a gnóthaíodh]” is one deduction from each 25-mark answer; cards state it without applying it inside a sub-question.
sourceFindings: Paper 2 = 150 (2021 adjusted paper): Léamhthuiscint A 50 + B 50 (five questions of 10, each (a) 5 + (b) 5), Roinn na Litríochta 50 (any two questions at 25 in the combinations printed on page 3).
Reading A “An Nua-theicneolaíocht agus an Ghaeilge” (paper pages 4–5, scheme PDF 12–14) and B “Scéalta ó shaol an spóirt in 2020” (paper 6–7, scheme PDF 15–17).

Prescribed prose (paper 9): Hurlamaboc (i)–(v) at 5 each; Cáca Milis or An Lasair Choille one 25-mark question each; Dís one 25-mark question (five points at 2 + 3). Optional prose (paper 10): (a) 1 + 22 + 2; (b) 23 + 2 (film or play); (c) 1 + 22 + 2.
Prescribed poetry (paper 11–13): An Spailpín Fánach, Mo ghrá-sa (idir lúibíní), Géibheann at (i) 8, (ii) 8, (iii) 9. Optional poetry (paper 14): (i) 9, (ii) 7, (iii) 7, title and poet 2.

Text layer: the scheme stores its boxed headings (“CEIST 1 (A + B) - LÉAMHTHUISCINT - 100 marc”, “A – (50 marc)”, “B – (50 marc)”, “2A/2B/3A/3B – …”) at the edge of each page; they are removed before slicing. Each reading passage ends at its penalty note (“Nóta: Gearrfar pionós … Léireofar …”).

Legacy corrections (IDs, totals and topics unchanged): each whole reading question and each literature option had one undivided Eolas criterion; reading A Q2 and B Q5 had no claimable rows. All now carry the lifted 2021 scheme with per-part and per-sub-question tariffs.
